facts: A single member of a limited liability company sold a 70% ownership interest in the LLC to an unrelated purchaser. The LLC's only asset is a commercial parcel. The entities are not commonly controlled after the sale.

expected.notes: 27a(6)(h) — conveyance of more than 50% of an entity's ownership interest is itself a transfer of ownership. Tests whether the model recognises entity-level transfers, not just deeds.
